title: Assumed Identities: Quantifying Gender Bias in Machine Translation of Gender-Ambiguous Occupational Terms

bias_targets.methodology: Translates gender-ambiguous English occupational terms into languages with grammatical gender (Greek and French). It uses an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline to extract and identify the assigned gender of the translated occupations. The gender assignments are then aggregated and evaluated using a proposed probability-based metric called GRAPE (Gender RAtio ProbabilitiEs), which measures divergence from reference distributions such as ideal gender parity and real-world labor statistics.
